fact: Egypt introduced EMIS-linked daily attendance monitoring, with attendance above 80% nationwide by the end of 2024/25, weekly attendance dashboards, and regional EMIS capacity that still varies.
title: Monitoring equity through verified data: how Egypt's 2025 education reforms are reframing progress and revealing what still must be done
publisher: World Education Blog (GEM Report), by Amira Awaad, Advisor to the Minister of Education and Technical Education
